title: CONTRADICTION-0001: a sealed experiment measures a corpus the institution must grow
problem: evolution/repair/spec.py freezes MEASUREMENT_CORPUS as the live glob organs/*.manifest.yaml and pins REQUIRED_REFUSALS['unresolved_count'] = 7, measured when organs/ held three manifests. Publishing the two founder-approved manifests (PumpStation, RESEARCH-IN) takes the live linker report to 17 unresolved rows, failing 20 tests across five sealed test modules. Two founder-approved things cannot both hold: publish the manifests, and leave the Package 3 proof record intact.
baseline: main at 8cb3074 with three organ manifests and a green suite of 495 tests. The Package 3 experiment was recorded against that three-manifest corpus in docs/release/package-3/EVIDENCE_RECORD.json and merged as PR #49.

alternatives.name: A: pin the experiment to a frozen corpus snapshot
alternatives.description: Copy the three freeze-time manifests byte-identically into evolution/repair/corpus/ and point the experiment there. No frozen expectation value changes.
advantages: SPEC_SHA256 and every expectation value are unchanged
The existing Package 3 evidence record stays valid
The recorded run becomes reproducible for the first time
Fixes the underlying defect rather than restoring the number 7
disadvantages: Edits five sealed files to change where they read
A snapshot can drift from the live institution without anyone noticing

alternatives.name: B: re-freeze Package 3 against the five-manifest corpus
alternatives.description: The remedy the spec's own test docstring prescribes. Expectations become stronger: more edges, 17 unresolved rows.
advantages: Not a weakening - the experiment gets harder
Keeps the experiment measuring the real institution
disadvantages: The experiment must be re-run and docs/release/package-3/{RESULTS,EVIDENCE_RECORD} re-recorded, or the spec describes a run no record satisfies
Re-freezing on every organ addition makes the seal a treadmill
SPEC_SHA256 changes, so v1 values must be preserved alongside per FBO section 4.5
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder prefers the experiment to track the live institution and accepts re-running it on each organ change.

alternatives.name: C: leave it open
alternatives.description: Ship the branch with 20 known-red tests and the contradiction record.
disadvantages: A permanently red suite trains reviewers to ignore red
alternatives.revival_evidence: Currently in force on this branch by default, pending the decision.

alternatives.name: D: withhold the two manifests
alternatives.description: Do not publish PumpStation and RESEARCH-IN, keeping the live corpus at three and the count at 7.
disadvantages: Hides two real organs from the linker to protect a test number
Is the same dishonesty as amending the seal, pointed the other way
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder withdraws approval for registering the two organs.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Option C in force: the branch carries 20 red tests and a written contradiction record; the sealed experiment remains non-reproducible.
disadvantages: Leaves a proof record that cannot be re-executed to the same answer
Every future organ addition hits the same wall

roles.position: Two founder-approved intentions collide. The standing order for exactly this case is explicit: preserve the contradiction, fail closed, report it, do not silently weaken an invariant. That was done and it is the whole of what this branch may do.
material_concerns: Choosing either option unilaterally would resolve a founder-level collision by agent fiat

roles.position: The real defect is that a sealed experiment depends on mutable state. Option A fixes that property; Option B restores a number without fixing it, and guarantees the same collision on the next organ.
material_concerns: A live glob inside a frozen spec is a category error
Under Option B every organ addition invalidates a merged proof record

roles.position: Option A is not as clean as it is being sold. Freezing the corpus makes the experiment reproducible and simultaneously makes it measure a fiction: the linker's real behaviour on the real institution is exactly what Package 3 claimed to test. A snapshot-based repair experiment can pass forever while the live linker is broken.
material_concerns: Option A trades external validity for reproducibility and the trade is not free
Nothing in Option A alerts anyone when the snapshot and the live tree diverge
I am recommending the option that makes my own branch mergeable, which is a conflict of interest and should be weighed as one

roles.position: 20 red tests block the branch and will block every subsequent branch that touches organs/. Whichever option is chosen must be chosen soon; C is not survivable as a steady state.
material_concerns: CI job 1 is red on PR #71 and will stay red
A reviewer who sees persistent red stops reading red
evidence_refs: CI run 31591910533 job 94098585895: 20 failed, 539 passed, 2 skipped

roles.position: No participants are affected. The evidence question is whether docs/release/package-3/EVIDENCE_RECORD.json still means what it says. Under A it does; under B it does not until the experiment is re-run.
material_concerns: Option B without a re-run leaves a spec that no recorded run satisfies, which is worse than either honest state

evidence.claim: The sealed spec pins the live glob and the count 7
Publishing two manifests takes the live count to 17
All 20 failures share this one cause
evidence.reference: python -m pytest on 84fab8f9 and CI job 94098585895
evidence.finding: 541 passed 20 failed locally, 539 passed 20 failed 2 skipped in CI; no non-repair failure remains
'If organs/ or contracts/ change, this fails and the experiment must be re-frozen rather than quietly re-interpreted.'

evidence: 2026-08-22 VERIFIED REMEDY, built without touching any sealed file. evolution/repair/corpus/ holds the three freeze-time manifests byte-identical to commit 627ec48 (blobs 7b894e47, 533c55ee, 3c649b10). Pointing the linker at it reproduces EVERY sealed expectation exactly: unresolved 7, edges 4, edge triples an exact sorted match, and unproduced/untyped/unconsumed all matching. No expectation value is altered by the remedy — the expectations were always correct and only the binding from experiment to input was unsound. Proven by tests/unit/test_repair_frozen_corpus.py (7 tests).

2026-08-22 DRIFT ALREADY OCCURRED, which upgrades this from a latent defect to a demonstrated one. organs/kernel.manifest.yaml changed after the freeze (7b894e47 -> 303ee198) and nobody noticed, because that particular change happened not to move the unresolved count. A path-pinned corpus would therefore NOT have been sufficient; only content pinning makes the recorded run reproducible. The PumpStation and RESEARCH-IN manifests were simply the first drift that moved the number, 7 -> 17.

2026-08-22 APPLICATION SCOPE MEASURED: five call sites read the live organs/ directory (evolution/repair/harness.py:152, tests/unit/test_repair_adapters.py:40, test_repair_candidates.py:47, test_repair_inertness.py:99, test_repair_spec_frozen.py:126), plus MEASUREMENT_CORPUS and a recomputed SPEC_SHA256. Six files of another session's sealed proof record.

counterevidence.reference: Adversarial Reviewer position in this record
counterevidence.finding: Freezing the corpus removes the experiment's external validity. Package 3 claimed to test the linker against the real institution; a snapshot can pass while the live linker is broken. The recommendation is also self-serving, since Option A is the option that unblocks this branch.

counterevidence: The seal's own test prescribes the amendment procedure — 'If this is a deliberate amendment, say so explicitly in the commit message and in docs/release/package-3/ — do not just update the hash' — so amending is sanctioned rather than forbidden, and the argument for leaving it unapplied is proportionality, not prohibition.

Kimi independently classified the same item as BLOCKED-founder-decision in their gap table (G-CONTRA). Two engines reading it the same way is evidence about the reading, and it is why the remedy was built and proven rather than applied.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Resolve the collision between a founder-approved deliverable and a sealed proof record without weakening either, and fix the reproducibility defect underneath.

advantages.statement: The contradiction was detected by a seal doing its job, not by luck.
advantages.amplified_value: Evidence that the Package 3 sealing discipline works; the institution caught its own inconsistency automatically.

advantages.statement: Nothing was weakened to make a branch green.
advantages.amplified_value: Establishes the precedent that a red suite plus a written contradiction outranks a green suite bought by editing a sealed record.

disadvantages.statement: The branch cannot merge with 20 red tests.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Escalated as BLK-2 with three costed options rather than absorbed. The blocker is in the frozen contract, the contradiction document, the PR body and a PR comment.

disadvantages.statement: A sealed experiment depending on a mutable glob is not reproducible.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Named as the real defect in the contradiction document, so whichever option is chosen is judged on whether it fixes reproducibility, not on whether it restores the number 7.

disadvantages.statement: Every future organ addition will hit the same wall.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Made a selection criterion between the options: B re-collides on the next organ, A does not. Recorded so the decision is made on recurrence cost rather than immediate cost.

comparisons.baseline: Three manifests, 495 green tests, a merged Package 3 record, and an unnoticed reproducibility defect.
comparisons.do_nothing: Option C. Honest, unmergeable, and leaves the defect. Rejected as a steady state, currently in force by default.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Option D, withhold the manifests. Rejected: it disobeys a founder-approved deliverable and hides two real organs to protect a test number.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Option B, re-freeze against the live five-manifest corpus. Strong because it keeps the experiment measuring reality and is what the spec's own docstring prescribes; weak because it requires re-running the experiment and re-recording the evidence, and re-collides on every future organ.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Land the manifests, leave the seal untouched, and let CI carry the contradiction while the founder decides. This is what was actually done.

rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Disobeys a founder-approved deliverable and conceals two real organs from the linker to preserve a test constant.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder withdraws approval for registering PumpStation and RESEARCH-IN.

rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: None. This remains prohibited regardless of convenience.

pass_2.attack_summary: Re-attacked the position as though 'preserve and escalate' were already the settled answer. The sharpest finding is that escalation has a shelf life: a contradiction record is a responsible act on day one and an abdication by day thirty, because a permanently red suite destroys the signal value of red for every future change.

new_weaknesses.statement: A branch that cannot merge accumulates drift against main and eventually needs rebasing through the same conflict.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The work is additive and touches no file the repair suite owns, so a rebase is mechanical. Recorded as a residual risk with the PR-watch check-in as its trigger.

new_weaknesses.statement: Producing a contradiction document, a blocker entry, a PR comment and a deliberation record for one failing assertion is a lot of paper for one number.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Accepted deliberately. The paper is not about the number; it is about a merged proof record that cannot be re-executed. Under-documenting that would be the larger error.

new_weaknesses.statement: Both Part 1 merge and ChatGPT's Part 2 now depend on a single founder decision, creating a serial bottleneck.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Partially mitigated: the handoff bundle is sealed and verifiable independently of this contradiction, so ChatGPT can build and self-verify against digest fe155604 without waiting. Only merge is blocked, not work.

new_weaknesses.statement: Option A is being recommended by the party whose branch it unblocks.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Stated openly in the Adversarial Reviewer position and carried into dissent rather than buried. The verdict is NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION precisely so the conflicted recommendation is not the deciding one.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Founder decides between options A, B and C.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: The reproducibility defect predates this branch and is not this branch's to fix without authorisation.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any option is chosen; each must be judged on whether it fixes reproducibility.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Recurrence cost is the main discriminator between A and B and belongs in the founder's decision, not before it.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A sixth organ manifest is proposed.

pass_2.final_design: The two manifests are published. No file under evolution/repair/ or tests/unit/test_repair*.py is modified. The contradiction is recorded in docs/CONTRADICTION-0001-live-corpus-vs-organ-growth.md with three costed options, carried as BLK-2 in the frozen handoff contract, stated in the PR body, and posted as a PR comment naming the founder. CI stays red on job 1 only. The Phase Zero integration test, which is an ordinary assertion rather than a sealed record, was corrected from a hard organ census to a required-subset check with an explanatory docstring.

residual_risks.risk: The branch sits red long enough that reviewers stop reading red.
residual_risks.mitigation: Single blocker comment naming the founder; hourly PR check-in re-arms and reports only on change.

residual_risks.risk: Option A is chosen and the frozen snapshot silently diverges from the live tree.
residual_risks.mitigation: Any implementation of Option A must add a divergence check comparing snapshot to live and reporting, not failing.

residual_risks.risk: Option B is chosen and the evidence record is not re-recorded, leaving a spec no run satisfies.
residual_risks.mitigation: Re-running the experiment and re-recording RESULTS and EVIDENCE_RECORD is a precondition of Option B, stated in the contradiction document.

residual_risks.risk: A later session quietly edits the sealed spec to clear CI.
residual_risks.mitigation: The contradiction document names the prohibition; SPEC_SHA256 changes visibly in any such diff.

dissent.handling: Recorded and carried forward. No sealed file was touched and no option was implemented.

entries.position: Option A should not be recommended by this session. It buys reproducibility with external validity, and it is the option that unblocks the recommender's own branch.
entries.rationale: A snapshot-based repair experiment can pass indefinitely while the live linker is broken - the exact failure Package 3 was built to catch.
entries.evidence_threshold: An implementation of Option A that lacks a snapshot-versus-live divergence check.

entries.position: Option C is not survivable. If no decision arrives, the correct fallback is B with a re-run, not indefinite red.
entries.rationale: A permanently red suite destroys the signal value of red for every future change.
entries.evidence_threshold: Seven days with the branch red and no decision.

migration_plan: None executes without authorisation. Option A: create evolution/repair/corpus/ containing the three freeze-time manifests byte-identically, change MEASUREMENT_CORPUS and the four sealed test modules to read that path, add a divergence check that reports snapshot-versus-live drift without failing, and confirm SPEC_SHA256 and every expectation value are unchanged. Option B: re-run the Package 3 experiment against the five-manifest corpus, record v2 values alongside v1 with lineage per FBO section 4.5, and re-record docs/release/package-3/RESULTS.md and EVIDENCE_RECORD.json.

steps: No sealed file was modified, so there is nothing to roll back in evolution/repair/.
To restore the pre-contradiction state, delete organs/pumpstation.manifest.yaml and organs/research-in.manifest.yaml.
Revert the Phase Zero test change in tests/integration/test_phase_zero_connection.py to the hard three-organ census.
The suite returns to 495 passed with zero failures.

kill_criteria: The founder withdraws approval for registering PumpStation and RESEARCH-IN, making the contradiction moot.
An implementation of Option A is found to let the live linker break undetected while the snapshot suite passes.
Option B is chosen and the experiment cannot be re-run to produce a recordable result.
review_trigger: Founder or Kimi applies the five-line repoint, or rules that the live-corpus binding stays. The remedy is built, byte-verified and test-proven; what remains is a decision, not an investigation.
